headline: After a Few Shrewd Picks, Put the Kittle On Hopes to Fight Hard
summary: Put the Kittle On had the fifth overall pick in the draft, putting together a roster that is poised to surprise. They focused on balance early, picking up a quarterback, running back, wide receiver, and tight end within their first five picks. By draft's end, Put the Kittle On secured a quartet of running backs with the most room for improvement.
